name: llm-project-docs
description: One plugin: a docs/ wiki the agent keeps current, with drift detection and pre-edit traps.

plugins.name: llm-project-docs
plugins.description: Docs that stay true to the code: the agent that changed the code updates the pages in the same turn. A docs/ wiki inside the repo, per-page verified_at so stale pages are computable, and hooks that show a file's recorded traps before it is edited.
